name: Eirdu
description: Eirdu is the elemental god and living embodiment of Lorwyn, the sun incarnation that forms the plane's twin worldsouls with Isilu.

summary.text: Eirdu is the elemental god and living embodiment of Lorwyn, the sun incarnation that forms the plane's twin worldsouls with Isilu.

bio.text: Eirdu and Isilu awaken from the firmament as the aspects merge, and they emerge after the downfall of Oona.

timeline.summary: Eirdu and Isilu awaken from the firmament as the aspects merge.
timeline.quote: two great beings awoke from the firmament above the plane: Eirdu, the incarnation of the sun, and Isilu, the incarnation of the moon.

citation.work: Planeswalker's Guide to Lorwyn Eclipsed
citation.text: "Planeswalker's Guide to Lorwyn Eclipsed" by Neale LaPlante Johnson, DK Billins, Laurel Pratt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Sep 2025.

timeline.summary: Maralen flees to the courtyard to find comfort with Eirdu.

citation.work: Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 2: Shake Off Slumber
citation.text: "Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 2: Shake Off Slumber" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 9 Dec 2025.

timeline.summary: As Eirdu leaves, patches of Shadowmoor open in the courtyard, and the blue faerie transforms back to green and follows Maralen.
timeline.quote: letting its transformation repeat in reverse, blue becoming green, smoothness becoming jagged and ornate.

citation.work: Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 2: Shake Off Slumber
citation.text: "Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 2: Shake Off Slumber" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 9 Dec 2025.

timeline.summary: Morcant explains her view of Eirdu and Isilu and sees Isilu's vulnerability as a chance to end the night forever and raise the Gilt-Leaf Empire again.
timeline.quote: If they could end the night forever, and welcome endless day in its place.

timeline.summary: Eirdu's belling cry halts the battle as Eirdu arrives and Oko drops from the air.
timeline.quote: A golden glow appeared on the horizon, growing brighter and brighter before rising like the sun, and Eirdu appeared.

citation.text: "Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 7: The Charm Dissolves Apace" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Dec 2025.

timeline.summary: Kirol spots Abigale alive, flying beside Eirdu.

timeline.summary: Isilu and Eirdu answer each other's calls and, instead of fighting, wrestle in play; Maralen declares the balance is here.
timeline.quote: Then Isilu returned the bow and pounced.

citation.work: Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 7: The Charm Dissolves Apace
citation.text: "Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 7: The Charm Dissolves Apace" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Dec 2025.

timeline.summary: Eirdu breathes on Tam, flaring the dawnglow in her wound, and she wakes and embraces Sanar.
timeline.quote: and she sat up, coughing, only to fall down again as Sanar flung himself at her

citation.work: Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 7: The Charm Dissolves Apace
citation.text: "Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 7: The Charm Dissolves Apace" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Dec 2025.

timeline.summary: Abigale explains that the merrow guarded the sleeping Eirdu and that it followed her back to the battlefield to fix the imbalance.
timeline.quote: The merfolk realized it was moving to fix the imbalances

timeline.summary: The elementals' dance ends; Isilu heads back toward its cavern as the night recedes and transformed kithkin and elves return to their Lorwyn selves.
timeline.quote: As the ribbons of night unwound, the transformed kithkin returned to their original states.

timeline.summary: Rhys thanks Eirdu and Maralen, then dissolves into flower petals and dies.
timeline.quote: His body came apart in flower petals, dawnglove and moonglove and apple blossom
